basic_info.description: Live above it all-style, space, and service in the heart of San Francisco. This top-floor, oversized 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo at La Galleria offers a beautifully renovated interior with clean, modern finishes and stunning atrium windows that flood the space with natural light. The updated kitchen features a rare skylight-bringing even more brightness into the heart of the home. Enjoy an airy, open layout ideal for relaxing or entertaining. La Galleria elevates your everyday lifestyle with luxury amenities including professional on-site management, 24-hour doorperson, elevator, secured garage parking, fitness center, and a landscaped plaza with sparkling pool. Forget all of your individual utilities! Monthly dues include water, heat, trash, cable, internet, and parking-delivering unmatched value and effortless comfort in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods. Whether you are seeking an energetic urban lifestyle or a refined pied-a-terre, this home offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and style.
